title: Using Casein Over a Pretextured Canvas Board
content: Here are some details of the little portrait of my wife shopping for veggies (link toYouTube video).The painting is in casein, and the way I use it is similar to the way I would paint in oil.You can see the underpainting texture made with acrylic modeling paste on the canvas covered board.You can see more casein paintings on theCasein playlist on my YouTube channelor the "casein" search term on this blog.Jack Richeson 37-Ml Artist Casein Colors, Set of 12
